data.title: Beverly Hills Plastic Surgeon Dr. David Sayah Reports Growing Demand for Breast Implant Removal and BBL Reversal
data.description: A plastic surgeon who is certified by the board has recently noted an increase in the number of patients opting for corrective surgeries aimed at restoring natural aesthetics. These procedures include breast implant removal, buttock reduction, and autologous fat grafting. This trend has been particularly prevalent in the Beverly Hills area, with the surgeon reporting a significant rise in such revision surgeries. The demand for these procedures has surged over the years, with a notable increase in patients seeking to achieve more proportionate and natural-looking results. This shift highlights a growing preference for subtle enhancements and a move away from more exaggerated cosmetic alterations.

data.title: SEI Names Joel Beherndt Managing Director of Seattle Office
data.description: SEI, a prominent employee-owned management consulting firm, has appointed Joel Beherndt as the new Managing Director of its Seattle branch. This move comes as SEI aims to further expand its presence and drive growth in the West region. The announcement was made on September 11, 2026. This strategic decision is part of SEI's initiatives to build on its current success and capitalize on the momentum in the market. Beherndt will play a crucial role in overseeing operations and overseeing the company's expansion efforts in Seattle and beyond. Under his leadership, SEI seeks to leverage its expertise and capitalize on emerging opportunities in the industry.

data.title: Pinnacle Fertility Network Expands into Northwest Arkansas
data.description: A new clinic under The Pinnacle Fertility Network is set to open in Bentonville, Arkansas. Scheduled to launch soon, this expansion into Northwest Arkansas aims to enhance access to fertility services. The facility will cater to patients seeking specialized care in the region.

data.title: U.S. Compliance Expands Chicago Presence to Meet Growing Safety and Environmental Compliance Demand
data.description: A prominent EHS leader in the nation is increasing their commitment to supporting manufacturers and other industrial employers in creating safer work environments. The company, U.S. Compliance (USC), renowned for their expertise in environmental, health, and safety compliance services, made the announcement in Minneapolis on September 11, 2026. This move aims to bolster regional investments in this sector, emphasizing the importance of workplace safety.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- Octapharma/
data.description: According to a recent news release, a secondary analysis of prespecified FIBRES subgroups has revealed that fibryga® resulted in fewer blood components being transfused compared to cryoprecipitate. The report was issued by Octapharma on 09-Sep-2026. The analysis found that the use of fibryga® led to a reduction in blood component transfusions, showcasing its potential impact in medical settings. This highlights the importance of considering alternative treatments, as fibryga® demonstrated its effectiveness in reducing the need for transfusions.

Experts suggest that immediate interventions are required to stabilize the job market and prevent further repercussions on the economy.

data.title: Ci Design, Inc. Partners with Ypsomed on Landmark US Manufacturing Facility
data.description: Ci Design, Inc. is collaborating with Ypsomed to establish Ypsomed's inaugural advanced manufacturing plant in Holly Springs, North Carolina. The facility, currently being built, aims to enhance the production of self-injection systems for the worldwide healthcare sector. Ypsomed, based in Burgdorf, Switzerland, has a workforce exceeding 2,000 individuals. This North American facility spans 160,000 square feet and is expected to provide substantial expansion prospects in the upcoming years.

data.title: NASA Postdoctoral Program Seeks Early Career and Senior Scientists for Prestigious Fellowships at Its Locations Across the U.S.
data.description: In Oak Ridge, Tennessee, NASA is seeking early-career and senior scientists for fellowship opportunities in its postdoctoral program. The deadline to apply for the current cycle of fellowships is November 1, 2026. Interested individuals can learn more or apply for fellowships in the NASA Postdoctoral Program (NPP), managed by ORAU for NASA. This program offers opportunities for scientists to contribute to advancements in science, technology, aeronautics, and space exploration.

data.title: Bloom Energy Hits the Road with ESPN College Football Campus Tour to Bring the Power Conversation to Communities Nationwide
data.description: In San Jose, California, Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) is partnering with ESPN College Football Campus Tour to embark on a season-long journey to spark discussions on the future of power at various college campuses nationwide. The initiative will fuse the energy of college football with community interaction and backing emergency response programs. The tour kicks off on September 12 in College Station, Texas, during the Arizona State versus Texas A&M game. Bloom Energy will be a prominent participant throughout the tour.
